text:
maria: quick heads-up — I'm proposing a schema change for audit.events: add a boolean `masked` and a `masked_keys` array so we can index searchable metadata but avoid storing raw PII in ES. looking for feedback on perf/cost and customer export flow.

kevin: do we actually need to keep raw payloads at all? some customers insist for e-discovery but that will balloon index size if we keep raw in ES.

amy: we should do tiered retention by customer tier. platinum customers can opt-in to raw retention (encrypted), standard gets masked-only. keeps cost bounded.

thomas: heads-up on ingestion scale: high-volume tenants already increase shards and mapping sizes. keeping raw JSON in ES could increase storage ~3x and slow indexing.

maria: right. my proposal: masked_event indexed in ES. raw_event, if requested, encrypted under tenant KMS and pushed to cold S3. ES stores `raw_blob_id` pointer. that keeps searches fast and cold storage cheap.

kevin: KMS integration Q: who holds the keys? per-tenant customer-managed KMS or org-managed? rotate? key access patterns matter for decryption latency during exports.

amy: compliance prefers per-tenant CMKs for isolation + rotation. for exports we will decrypt server-side once per export stream. not a per-event decrypt on search.

security-bot: NOTE: PCI/PHI customers require per-tenant key rotation and an audit trail of key usage. file SEC-3421 for KMS runbook and rotation policy.

thomas: implementation sketch: audit-writer does: mask_event -> index to `audit.v2` with minimal fields (timestamp, actor, action, resource, masked_keys, priority) -> if tenant opted-in, encrypt raw_event -> put to S3 -> index `raw_blob_id`.

maria: backpressure question: our current writer (single kafka topic -> consumer group) can pile up under spikes. suggestions for graceful degradation?

kevin: plan: batching + adaptive sampling. accept at ingress, place into hot queue for immediate index. if hot queue > threshold, move low-priority events to cold queue to be batched and archived later. also emit metrics/rejection-rate to alerting.

amy: schema change suggestion: add `priority` enum (high|medium|low) and `sampling_decision` (kept|sampled|dropped). this lets us reason about downstream gaps for customers.

thomas: cost back-of-envelope for raw S3 + ES index: assume 1k events/sec raw per tenant avg payload 3KB -> ~259GB/day raw -> 7.7TB/month. S3 (standard infrequent access) ~ $0.0125/GB => ~$96/mo per high-volume tenant just storage. ES index overhead + replicas could be 2-3x that. so clearly need cold path.

kevin: nice. we should include a per-tenant budget knob to disable raw retention when cost exceeds threshold or require commercial agreement.

amy: sample audit_writer config we can use for perf testing:
```
audit_writer:
  batch_size: 500
  max_queue_ms: 200
  sampling:
    low_rate: 0.01
    medium_rate: 0.5
    high_rate: 1.0
  cold_path_threshold: 100000 # queue length
```

thomas: testing notes: we need to run load tests with realistic tenant skews (1 large tenant at 1k/s, others smaller). validate end-to-end latency: ingestion -> ES ack vs cold-path ack. also measure decryption throughput for exports.

kevin: export flow: user requests raw export -> authz checks (RBAC) -> fetch list of `raw_blob_id` -> stream from S3 -> decrypt with tenant CMK -> stream to customer. must ensure RBAC only allows legal/cust-admin/special support roles.

maria: on RBAC, add `audit_export` role and limit to groups: legal, cust-admin, infra-support (with JIT approval). update policies and console UI.

security-bot: created SEC-3421 and assigned to thomas. also created checklist: key rotation, key access log retention, export authorization audit, and compromise runbook.

amy: migration/backfill considerations: new fields need defaults. mask existing docs with a backfill job that computes masked_keys and sets `masked: true` for legacy PII. need to throttle backfill to avoid overload.

thomas: I'll draft a PR: migration script + writer change + S3 archiver + config for sampling. will include perf tests Monday.

maria: awesome. please include a small dashboard for queue lengths, sampling rates, and exported bytes so we can quantify cost.

kevin: also add alert when cold-path queue growth rate > 5%/min for 5m. might indicate indexing bottleneck.

maria: thanks all :thumbsup: I'll sync with compliance on retention tiers and then we'll start the RFC.

sre-bot: deploybot: perf-test cluster provisioned for thomas — /cc @thomas

thomas: got it, will start load tests tomorrow.

maria: end
